answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. What survives to the onyx is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A dawn of per-task receipts records who did what, and the prism of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
